subject_uz: Neft qazib chiqarish obyektlarida 30 m3 li avtosisternalarda neftni tonna-kilometr hisobida tashish xizmati

requirements.summary_uz: Xizmat 30 m3 hajmli neft tashuvchi avtosisternalarda ko'rsatiladi, haq tonna-kilometr bo'yicha to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The service uses 30 m3 oil-carrying tank trucks, paid per tonne-kilometre.
requirements.quote: 30 m3 hajmdagi neft tashuvchi avtosisternatarda neft tashish xizmatlarini

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir texnika birligi sun'iy yo'ldosh (GPS) monitoringi va datchiklar bilan jihozlangan bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: Every vehicle must be fitted with satellite (GPS) monitoring and sensors.
requirements.quote: Har bir maxsus texnika birligi yuqori uskunaning ishlashini nazorat qiluvchi datchiklar va bort

requirements.summary_uz: Xavfli yuklarni tashish uchun zarur litsenziya va ruxsat hujjatlari bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Licences and permits for carrying hazardous cargo are required.
requirements.quote: xavfli yuklarni tashish uchun zarur litsenziyalar va ruxsat beruvchi hujjatlarning

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib berish bazasi: Andijon, Farg'ona va Namangan hududlari.
requirements.summary_en: Service base: the Andijan, Fergana and Namangan areas.
requirements.quote: 16.2 Yetkazib berish bazasi: Andijon, Farg'ona va Namangan hududlarida

requirements.summary_uz: Texnika shartnomadan keyin 10 kalendar kungacha quyish punktlariga yetkazilsa 10 ball (21-30 kun: 3 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Delivery of vehicles to the loading points within 10 calendar days scores 10 points (21-30 days: 3 points).
requirements.quote: Buyurtmachining quyish punktlariga texnikani 10 kalendar kungacha yetkazib berishni tasdiqlovchi kafolat xati

requirements.summary_uz: Park yoshi: 2020-yildan keyingi texnika 15 ball, 2010-yildan keyingi 10 ball, undan eskisi 0 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Fleet age: vehicles built 2020 or later score 15, 2010 or later 10, older 0.
requirements.quote: Sisternalar parkidagi texnikalarning ishlab chiqarilgan yili va texnik holati

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha haydovchilarning xavfli yuklarni tashishga ruxsat hujjatlari bo'lishi uchun 25 ball.
requirements.summary_en: 25 points for all drivers holding permits to carry hazardous cargo.
requirements.quote: Barcha haydovchilarning xavfli yuklarni tashishga ruxsat hujjatlari bilan

requirements.summary_uz: Neft va neft mahsulotlarini tashish tajribasi: 3 yil va undan ortiq 15 ball, 2 yil 10 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Experience carrying oil and oil products: 3+ years 15 points, 2 years 10 points.
requirements.quote: Neft va neft mahsulotlarini tashish tajribasi

requirements.summary_uz: GPS monitoring majburiy; shartnomadan keyin barcha transportga o'rnatilib, login va parol beriladi (25 ball).
requirements.summary_en: GPS monitoring is mandatory; installed on all vehicles after signing, with login and password supplied (25 points).
requirements.quote: Majburiy talab: maxsus texnikaning har bir birligi boftdagi sun'iy yo'ldosh monitoringi

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik taklif kamida 70 ball (100 dan) to'plashi kerak, aks holda qabul qilinmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: A technical offer must reach at least 70 of 100 points or it is rejected.
requirements.quote: Ballarning maksimal miqdori - 100. 70 balldan kam to'plagan texnik taklif qabul qilinmaydi.

documents_needed_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik haqidagi hujjat va ta'sis hujjatlari
Soliq va yig'imlar bo'yicha qarzdorlik yo'qligi haqida ma'lumotnoma
Insofsiz ijrochilar yagona reyestrida qayd etilmaganlik haqida ma'lumot
Majburiy ijro byurosi bazasida bajarilmagan majburiyatlar yo'qligi haqida ma'lumot
Manfaatlar to'qnashuvi va affillanganlik holatlari yo'qligi haqida ma'lumot
Texnik pasportlar va amaldagi kalibrlash pasportlari
Transport vositalarining 3-sinf xavfli yuklarni tashishga ruxsat guvohnomalari
Haydovchilik guvohnomalari va ADR guvohnomalari nusxalari, shtatdagi xodimlar soni haqida ma'lumotnoma
Texnika ro'yxati (ishlab chiqarilgan yili, markasi, sisterna hajmi) va sozligini tasdiqlovchi kafolat xati
GPS monitoring o'rnatish va login-parol berish haqida kafolat xati
Texnikani quyish punktlariga yetkazish muddati haqida kafolat xati
Neft tashish tajribasini tasdiqlovchi shartnomalar, dalolatnomalar va buyurtmachilar fikrlari
